Norman B. Leventhal Map & Education Center Collection

collection

Maps of Boston (including Chinatown) from the 1800s to the present day and atlases showing buildings and owners from the 1870s to 1980s. The collection also includes plans and maps from the Boston Redevelopment Authority (1960s to 1990s).
